items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Tell us a little bit about Mrs. Hightower; you did work with her on occasion?

ctx.x: Around that time Mr. Blakeney, there were several really talented and unusual women musicians; Mrs. Alma Hightower (phonetic spelling) was one, who later became a teacher of some outstanding students; Mrs. Loretta Butler, who was also a dancing teacher; and Miss Fannie (?) Benjamin, who is yet with us and playing.
Tell us a little bit about Mrs. Hightower; you did work with her on occasion?
